summary: Southwestern Electric Power Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a public offering of senior notes, Series S, with the principal amount, coupon, maturity, and pricing left blank in this preliminary version. The notes are unsecured, rank equally with other unsecured and unsubordinated debt, are effectively subordinated to secured debt, and are redeemable at the Company's option. Joint book-running managers are CIBC Capital Markets, Fifth Third Securities, J.P. Morgan, and US Bancorp. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown off an existing shelf, not a special situation.
